description:
We are seeking a dedicated SDC/Infection Control Nurse to join a premier health and rehabilitation center in Oakland, MD. This vital role combines the responsibilities of Staff Development Coordination with comprehensive Infection Control oversight, ensuring the highest standards of patient care and staff competency. You will play a crucial part in maintaining a safe and compliant environment for both residents and employees.

This full-time position offers a competitive hourly rate of $40-$42, reflecting your expertise and commitment. If you are an experienced Registered Nurse passionate about education and infection prevention, we encourage you to apply and contribute to a facility dedicated to excellence.
requirements: Active Registered Nurse (RN) license in Maryland
Proven experience in staff development and education within a healthcare setting
Demonstrated experience in infection prevention and control practices
Strong knowledge of state and federal regulations related to infection control and staff education
salaryOrBonusInfo: Hourly rate of $40-$42 based on experience.
